source: SPM Essay · Essay on preserving local cultural heritage (older format, no trial paper named)
paragraphs: Malaysia is a nation rich in diverse customs and arts, but due to rapid modernisation, many valuable traditions are now under threat. It is an imperative duty for young Malaysians to step forward and actively contribute to preserving these priceless elements of our culture for future generations.

Several unique traditions are currently facing the risk of disappearing entirely. For instance, the art of Wayang Kulit (shadow puppetry) and the complex technique of making hand-drawn Batik are struggling to survive. These crafts require dedicated skills and time, but they are often overshadowed by modern entertainment and cheaper, factory-made products. If we do not make an effort to learn them, these historical practices and the stories they carry will fall into oblivion.

Saving our culture is vitally important for maintaining a strong and stable nation. Firstly, it gives every citizen a clear sense of identity and belonging, connecting them to their ancestors. Secondly, sharing traditions creates social cohesion among our diverse ethnic groups, helping everyone live together peacefully. Furthermore, our unique heritage attracts tourists, which provides significant socio-economic benefits for the entire country.

To encourage teenagers, we must make learning about culture fun and accessible. Schools should incentivise participation by offering engaging workshops and making these arts part of hands-on projects. We must also harness the power of social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram. Short, creative videos demonstrating traditional cooking or cultural facts can make heritage seem modern and cool, encouraging more students to get involved.
